routes.title: The Contractor AI Website & Growth System | Agile Marketing Systems
routes.description: See how Agile connects websites, local SEO, project proof, lead capture, automation, content, reputation and reporting into one contractor growth system.
routes.headline: One connected growth system instead of a stack of disconnected vendors
routes.intro: The website is the presentation layer. The real product is the operating system around it: local visibility, proof, lead capture, follow-up and measurable growth working from one structured foundation.

sections.heading: Website and local search
sections.body: Fast contractor-specific pages, structured services and markets, schema, internal linking and project signals are designed together.

sections.heading: Lead capture and automation
sections.body: Forms, calls, qualification, routing, scheduling and follow-up are connected to the same growth system rather than bolted on later.

sections.heading: Project proof and content
sections.body: Verified completed work becomes reusable proof, local-search content, case studies and sales material without inventing customer outcomes.

sections.heading: Constraint-driven growth
sections.body: Reporting is used to identify the limiting step in the funnel so the next improvement is aimed at throughput instead of random marketing activity.

routes.title: AI Websites for Contractors | Agile Marketing Systems
routes.description: See how Agile builds fast, structured contractor websites from niche configuration, verified business facts and reusable Website Factory components.
routes.headline: A contractor website built from a system, not a blank page
routes.intro: The Website Factory starts with approved structure, niche modules, business facts, proof rules and conversion paths so AI accelerates production without inventing the business.

sections.heading: Structured before generated
sections.body: Services, markets, calls to action, proof sources and page relationships are defined in configuration before content is rendered.

sections.heading: Niche-specific by design
sections.body: The common operating layer is reusable, while service architecture, FAQs, lead flows and proof patterns change by contractor niche.

sections.heading: Human QA stays in the loop
sections.body: Generated output is checked for accuracy, links, claims, metadata, mobile behavior and conversion readiness before production release.

sections.heading: Portable output
sections.body: The front end remains static and exportable so the website is not trapped inside a proprietary presentation stack.

routes.title: Local SEO Systems for Contractors | Agile Marketing Systems
routes.description: Build contractor local-search infrastructure around services, locations, projects, internal links, schema and verified proof instead of isolated SEO tasks.
routes.headline: Build local search around the work your company actually does
routes.intro: Local SEO works better when service pages, market pages, projects, proof and technical structure reinforce one another instead of living in separate campaigns.

sections.heading: Service and market architecture
sections.body: Core services and target markets are mapped into a deliberate site structure with unique intent instead of thin duplicate location pages.

sections.heading: Projects become local signals
sections.body: Verified completed jobs can support project pages, related service pages, local relevance and future case-study content.

sections.heading: Technical foundations
sections.body: Canonicals, metadata, schema, internal links, crawlability and index controls are treated as part of the build rather than cleanup work after launch.

sections.heading: Growth by evidence
sections.body: Expansion follows search visibility, lead quality and conversion evidence so content production stays tied to business throughput.

routes.title: Get Started | Contractor Growth System | Agile Marketing Systems
routes.description: Start with a contractor growth-system assessment focused on the biggest constraint in visibility, conversion, proof or follow-up.
routes.headline: Find the constraint. Then build the system around it.
routes.intro: The first step is mapping your current website, local search, proof, lead capture and follow-up so we can identify what is actually limiting growth.

sections.heading: What we’ll map
sections.body: Your current site, primary services and markets, lead sources, proof assets, CRM/follow-up process and the bottlenecks between them.

sections.heading: What you’ll get
sections.body: A practical view of what should be standardized, what should be niche-specific and which system improvement should come first.
